gen-dafont-quantum-satoshi: Satoshi has a tall, friendly lowercase with every stroke drawn at one width. Quantum up top is loosely spaced and techy, so a longer read feels like drifting down a bright, uncluttered hallway.
gen-dafont-plakkaat-fs-asap: Asap keeps its curves open and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Plakkaat is the heavy, nearly closed-up half, and that tension between curled-shut and open letters is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads like bent wire, curvy and loose, with a tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips. And Visitor's pixel-era gaping e shapes and short ascenders over big bowls give the pair a nostalgic digital wink.
gen-dafont-woodgod-fs-supreme: Woodgod's tall lowercase, nearly as high as its capitals, gives it a vintage, commanding stance. And Supreme follows with a crisp, heavy-looking line whose letters stay held open instead of curling shut.
gen-eater-fs-public-sans: Eater brings a dark, aggressive look, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders over its quiet stroke contrast. Public Sans feels sturdy beside it.
gen-flavors-general-sans: Whimsical and towering, Flavors stacks its x-height like a stubby pencil stroke, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. General Sans does the quieter job, running a steady line with smooth curves that fill the line.
gen-gf-autour-one-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright open gap at every curve and a pen line that holds one width throughout. Autour One, bold and expressive, sits above it, so reading downward stays smooth.
gen-gf-goldman-montserrat: Commanding in a wide stance, Goldman spreads its letters with generous clearance and a big lowercase. Montserrat glides under it like wire, with oversized e and a counters and a plain, unshaded line.
gen-gf-grandstander-switzer: Chunky, bright and a bit cheeky. Grandstander is best at loud, expressive headings with short ascenders and tall x-height, while Switzer handles the quiet work with wire-like letterforms and c tips that never creep shut.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-bespoke-sans: Happy Monkey draws a ruler-straight line, like a ballpoint's pressure-free stroke. It earns its keep big and short, while Bespoke Sans adds sharp, refined curves with generous space before each stem.
